cells.tense: Right now you are carrying the weight of real things without forcing, and it holds.
cells.act: carry on with the version you chose through another week of doubt
cells.ask: Take the version you settled on in a doubtful hour and keep it one more week — the next plain step each day, with nothing confirming you are right.
cells.core:
You can hold a real weight without crushing it. That is the shape here: pressing on through material things with what you already have, not what you are handed, and the abstract seat lets the mechanism show its bare bones — what persists is not the pressure but the choice inside it.

The next phase has already started. Keep following what you set out on through another week of doubt, doing the small material acts as they come. What you get is a persistence that grows because you keep feeding it hope. Nothing here needs proving to anyone, and no sign is owed you. The kept choice is itself the thing, and it keeps without confirmation.
cells.sheetLine: The weight holds because you keep choosing it.
cells.verb: holding steady through the weight of real things
cells.place: in the abstract pattern where the mechanism shows its bare shape

cells.tense: You are bracing for a future weight that has not arrived, gripping a problem you cannot write yet.
cells.act: let the exchange with someone run both ways
cells.ask: Choose one person and let the exchange with them run both ways — if you carry something for them, let them carry something back.
cells.core:
Your grip has gone hard for what the moment asks, and the abstract seat shows the pattern cleanly: endurance stretched into bracing, moving on a future weight that has not landed. The steady strength has become something forced rather than something that carries you forward.

Exchange is what loosens it. Choose one person and let the exchange with them run both ways — carry something for them, and let them carry something back. Fairness returns without a ledger, and the strength keeps its lift. Strength that gives and receives stays light; strength that only carries goes tight. One exchange, run both ways.
cells.sheetLine: Your grip is outrunning the weight.
cells.verb: holding steady through the weight of real things
cells.place: in the abstract pattern where the mechanism shows its bare shape

cells.tense: You are still standing at a door you already carried something through, and it stays shut.
cells.act: stand where the giving can be witnessed
cells.ask: Do what you carry someplace it can be seen — the room, the table, the doorway — and keep doing it there. No speech, no explaining.
cells.core:
The endurance is real, and it has left you outside the room. In the abstract seat this shows plainly: the strength itself is intact, but it runs on old material, and what you have spent has no witness. You arrive at the weight and none of the trip returns to you.

What is thin is visibility, not strength. Do what you carry someplace it can be seen — the room, the table, the doorway — and keep doing it there. No speech, no explaining. That is enough to return some charge to the place that has gone empty. What follows is release, completion with nothing owing, and it can be had in full.
cells.sheetLine: The strength is real and no one has seen its weight.
cells.verb: holding steady through the weight of real things
cells.place: in the abstract pattern where the mechanism shows its bare shape

cells.tense: The strength in this has a hand on it, and the hand is going undated.
cells.act: go on toward it without needing a sign
cells.ask: Notice once, the next time you hold through something heavy, that you are the one doing it. Then go on — one step, no sign.
cells.core:
On this stretch the strength is real and private: pressing through material pressure with no one watching, and the keeper of it has no name attached. Ask and you would say it simply runs. What you are doing is there in plain sight, and the one doing it is filed under the circumstances.

The move is small and belongs to you alone. Notice once, the next time you hold through something heavy, that you are the one doing it — then go on, one step, no sign. You are still following what you chose, and that is the steady part; the only thing missing is standing beside the act instead of outside it. The same strength follows.
cells.sheetLine: This strength is yours. You have been filing it under circumstances.
